note: Cursor doesn't reload hooks.json in a running agent: this takes effect in new `agent` sessions; the hooks are inert until a session joins a room
note: idle Cursor sessions are reached by a parked stop hook (tier cursor:stop-park, provisional: parks longer than ~40 s are unproven until the Cursor re-test)
